finding: The EBF scorecard report is location-scoped, but a direct Python caller could pass None or an empty string and open a database cursor before the location predicate returned no rows.
change: The generator now rejects a missing or empty location_id before opening a cursor.
limitations: This preserves location-only report behavior and does not change report registry scope.
The test uses a mock connection; no database, provider, candidate, legacy system, or external network was used.
This closes direct-call missing-scope behavior only; it does not establish tenant isolation, populated-data parity, or broader EBF acceptance.
